schema.Create Table:
CREATE TABLE `chat_messages` (
  `id` bigint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '消息编号',
  `conversation_id` bigint NOT NULL COMMENT '所属聊天会话编号',
  `role` varchar(16) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'user用户消息，assistant模型回复',
  `content` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '消息正文',
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '创建时间',
  `recommendation_json` json DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '当次导购结果快照，普通文字消息为空',
  `message_type` varchar(16) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL DEFAULT 'TEXT' COMMENT 'TEXT普通消息，CART_ACTION购物车确认提示',
  `cart_operation_id` varchar(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '确认提示关联的购物车操作编号',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_chat_messages_cart_operation` (`cart_operation_id`),
  KEY `idx_chat_messages_conversation_id` (`conversation_id`,`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_chat_messages_cart_operation` FOREIGN KEY (`cart_operation_id`) REFERENCES `cart_actions` (`operation_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_chat_messages_conversation` FOREIGN KEY (`conversation_id`) REFERENCES `chat_conversations` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_chat_messages_content` CHECK ((char_length(trim(`content`)) > 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_chat_messages_role` CHECK ((`role` in (_utf8mb4'user',_utf8mb4'assistant'))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_chat_messages_tool_payload` CHECK ((((`message_type` = _utf8mb4'TEXT') and (`cart_operation_id` is null)) or ((`message_type` = _utf8mb4'CART_ACTION') and (`role` = _utf8mb4'assistant') and (`recommendation_json` is null) and (`cart_operation_id` is not null))))
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=117 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='聊天会话中的消息'
